messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 4 error
parts:
Just posting an error message and expecting others to investigate it for you is not very nice. GGIR is open-source software and all help provided via this e-mail list is on a voluntary basis. Please make the effort to share a reproducible example and as much detail on what you already did to investigate the problem. In that way I or others may be able to help without having to spend a lot of time.

Thank,

Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
